instructions: Read existing dashboards and match keys/titles before creating. Preserve legacy insights and data; update or clearly label old coverage instead of deleting.
Resolve the project from authenticated PostHog UI/API and verify it matches the public capture token without printing the token.
Resolve each dashboard ID, then POST/PATCH insight bodies with name, description, tags, query, and dashboards=[resolved_id]. Never send the local key field to the API.
Use existing account defaults for visibility. Do not enable public dashboard sharing or email subscriptions.
Validate query nodes through the authenticated query endpoint, inspect rendered insights, and record resulting dashboard URLs. Empty results at cutover are expected; do not fabricate historic events.
Set cutover_date to the actual production release date after verification.

Workflow attribution begins with the production release carrying workflow_page. Do not backfill earlier events. workflow_page is a fixed enum (tracing, tileset, animation, sprite_sheet), not a URL or referrer.

dashboards.name: PixelWall — Website & downloads
dashboards.description: Only consenting browsers on the public site, after the schema 2 launch. No historical backfill, private preview traffic, desktop usage, or visitors who decline analytics. Pseudonymous browser counts are not people. Download clicks do not establish completed downloads or installs. Referral sources describe the immediate referrer; they are not persistent marketing attribution.

insights.name: Consenting browsers visiting PixelWall
insights.description: Only consenting browsers on the public site, after the schema 2 launch. No historical backfill, private preview traffic, desktop usage, or visitors who decline analytics. Pseudonymous browser counts are not people.

insights.name: Page views by area
insights.description: Page view totals, split into fixed page groups; no raw path or query reporting.

insights.name: Workflow page views by workflow
insights.description: Consenting-browser page views for the fixed tracing, tileset, animation, and sprite-sheet workflow categories. This is a directional page-view count, not a unique-visitor or conversion measure; coverage starts with the workflow attribution release and has no historical backfill.

insights.name: Aggregate traffic counts by page area
insights.description: Server-side daily counts from the Essential-only aggregate measurement path, split by fixed page group. Each event uses a fresh identifier and is not a unique visitor, session, or people count; do not compare it directly with consenting-browser DAU or interpret it as Search Console clicks.

insights.name: Aggregate download clicks by platform
insights.description: Server-side daily download-click counts from Essential-only aggregate measurement, split by fixed platform. Counts are actions, not unique visitors, sessions, completed downloads, or installs.

insights.name: Aggregate workflow actions by workflow
insights.description: Anonymous aggregate action totals split by the fixed workflow_page enum. These are unrelated page-view, first-edit, and successful generated-export actions, not linked journeys, unique visitors, or conversion rates. Coverage begins with the workflow attribution release and has no historical backfill.

insights.name: Aggregate navigation clicks by destination
insights.description: Server-side daily navigation-click counts from Essential-only aggregate measurement, split by fixed destination. Counts are actions, not unique visitors or sessions.

insights.name: Aggregate exports by type
insights.description: Server-side daily export-outcome counts from Essential-only aggregate measurement, split by reviewed export type. Counts are export actions, not unique visitors, sessions, or saved files.

insights.name: Aggregate export outcomes
insights.description: Server-side daily export counts split into success, failure, and blocked outcomes. Counts are actions, not unique visitors, sessions, or saved files.

insights.name: Page views by immediate referral source
insights.description: Immediate referrer classification only. A later internal page can replace the external source. direct_or_unknown combines direct visits and unavailable referrers.

insights.name: Navigation clicks by destination
insights.description: Fixed link destinations only; repeated clicks count as repeated events.

insights.name: Desktop download clicks by platform
insights.description: Clicks on versioned download links. This does not measure download completion, installation, or app use.

insights.name: Desktop download clicks by release
insights.description: Useful during release rollout; click totals can include retries.

insights.name: Downloads page → desktop download click
insights.description: Ordered anonymous-browser funnel, within 1 day. Does not include a completed-download or installation step.

dashboards.name: PixelWall — Product signals
dashboards.description: Aggregate Essential-only action counts are anonymous totals and are not conversions or linked journeys. Optional reports use consenting, pseudonymous browsers to show product journeys; they do not prove causation, completed saves, installs, purchases, or revenue. Generated exports mean files prepared by the editor, not necessarily files saved to disk.

insights.name: Aggregate creations and successful exports
insights.description: Daily Essential-only aggregate action totals: editor activation as creation and successful generated exports. These are unrelated anonymous actions, not unique users or a conversion rate.

insights.name: Aggregate Pro restrictions by export type
insights.description: Daily Essential-only aggregate counts of exports blocked because Pro is required, split by export type. These are anonymous actions, not unique users or unmet demand.

insights.name: Aggregate live checkout interest
insights.description: Daily Essential-only aggregate counts of live checkout starts. These are anonymous actions, not unique visitors, completed payments, or revenue.

insights.name: Optional editor loaded → activated → export
insights.description: A one-day ordered funnel for consenting, pseudonymous browsers across both editors. Export means generated output; this does not prove causation or a saved file.

insights.name: Tracing page → editor → export
insights.description: A one-day ordered funnel for consenting, pseudonymous browsers whose fixed workflow_page is tracing. It measures page view, editor load, meaningful activation, and generated export; it does not prove causation, a saved file, or a unique person. Coverage begins with the workflow attribution release and has no historical backfill.

insights.name: Tileset page → editor → export
insights.description: A one-day ordered funnel for consenting, pseudonymous browsers whose fixed workflow_page is tileset. It measures page view, editor load, meaningful activation, and generated export; it does not prove causation, a saved file, or a unique person. Coverage begins with the workflow attribution release and has no historical backfill.

insights.name: Optional Pro restriction → live checkout
insights.description: A seven-day ordered funnel for consenting, pseudonymous browsers: a Pro-required export block followed by a live checkout start. The dialog step is omitted because it can occur before the restriction; this does not prove causation or purchase.

insights.name: Optional Pro restrictions and checkout starters
insights.description: Daily consenting-browser counts for Pro-required export blocks and live checkout starts. These are two separate series with no implied conversion relationship.

dashboards.name: PixelWall — Editor & exports
dashboards.description: Only consenting browsers on the public site, after the schema 2 launch. No historical backfill, private preview traffic, desktop usage, or visitors who decline analytics. Pseudonymous browser counts are not people. Generated exports indicate files prepared by the editor; they do not prove the user saved a file to disk. Activation funnel is scoped to the current workbench.

insights.name: Editor browsers by version
insights.description: Anonymous browser counts by workbench/classic. A load is not a meaningful edit.

insights.name: Workbench → meaningful edit → generated export
insights.description: Ordered within 1 day. Activation is measured only after consent; existing artwork does not produce historical activation. Export completion is editor generation, not disk-save confirmation.

insights.name: First meaningful editor actions
insights.description: First meaningful edit recorded by the current consented editor lifecycle; fixed action classes only.

insights.name: Workbench tool adoption
insights.description: Counts anonymous browsers using each tool family; no pointer paths, artwork, or stroke contents.

insights.name: Generated exports by format
insights.description: Files generated by the editor. The browser/OS may cancel or decline the subsequent save.

insights.name: Export starts, completions, failures, and blocks
insights.description: Independent counts, not a success-rate formula: starts can complete in another time bucket and repeated export attempts are separate.

insights.name: Completed imports by format
insights.description: Fixed format categories; no filenames or imported content.

insights.name: External automation operations
insights.description: Coarse successful external-control operation counts. This measures the free scripting interface, not embedded AI, and sends no script or command arguments.

dashboards.name: PixelWall — Agents & AI referrals
dashboards.description: Hosted automation and separately opted-in desktop MCP reports. Counts are operations, not unique users or verified agents. Edits, export generation, retrieval storage and verified disk saves are distinct. Consented hosted edits are a subset of aggregate edits. CLI, standalone and desktop 0.5.0 remain untracked; no backfill.

insights.name: Anonymous automated edits by operation
insights.description: Aggregate successful changed hosted-editor automation edits only. Includes apply, Lua, color-profile, undo and redo operations; no agent IDs, scripts, artwork, document names or command arguments are retained. Counts are events, not visitors or sessions.

insights.name: Anonymous automated export outcomes
insights.description: Aggregate export outcomes explicitly attributed to hosted automation. Break down by success, failure and blocked; older exports without a source remain unattributed and are not reassigned.

insights.name: Consented successful agent edits (subset)
insights.description: Optional consented browser events for successful changed hosted-editor automation edits. This is a more detailed subset of aggregate automated edits, not an additional total; it is not a visitor or agent count and includes no agent identity.

insights.name: Hosted automation workflow operations
insights.description: Anonymous operation totals including previews, validation, project and artifact actions. Operations may be read-only or fail; use the separate changed-edit chart for actual artwork changes. No unique-agent count.

insights.name: Hosted automation operation outcomes
insights.description: Terminal success, failure, cancelled, blocked and missing outcomes. A successful read-only call is not an edit. Request-key retries share the original terminal result.

insights.name: Desktop MCP operations (opt-in)
insights.description: Anonymous reports only from updated packaged desktop apps with Share anonymous MCP usage enabled. Desktop 0.5.0, CLI and standalone use are excluded. Missing counts do not prove no usage.

insights.name: Desktop MCP operation outcomes (opt-in)
insights.description: Terminal MCP outcomes from explicitly opted-in updated desktop apps. No agent identities or historical backfill. Validation failures, cancellation and missing artifacts are separate outcomes.

insights.name: Desktop MCP edits, exports and verified saves
insights.description: Separate action counts: changed artwork, generated exports, and save_artifact after hash and disk verification. These totals are not a linked funnel or conversion rate. Exports and saves can be repeated.

insights.name: Export retrieval storage outcomes
insights.description: Whether generated exports entered artifact retrieval storage. persisted does not mean a browser download completed or an MCP file was saved to disk. Hosted and opted-in desktop reports stay separate.

dashboards.name: PixelWall — Pro & reliability
dashboards.description: Only consenting browsers on the public site, after the schema 2 launch. No historical backfill, private preview traffic, desktop usage, or visitors who decline analytics. Pseudonymous browser counts are not people. Live checkout outcomes only where a billing mode applies. Verified ownership claims are browser-observed entitlement events, not authoritative payments or revenue; discounts, gifts, retries, refunds, taxes, and unconsented purchases are not revenue accounting.

insights.name: Pro details → checkout → verified ownership
insights.description: Ordered within 7 days. Billing-mode filters are on payment steps only because dialog events do not carry billing mode. Return URL success is deliberately not the paid/verified conversion step. Browser identifiers may change across devices or after storage resets.

insights.name: Checkout start → Stripe → verified ownership
insights.description: Operational conversion among consented live-checkout attempts. Entitlement success requires a verified owned license; online-only legacy access is shown separately.

insights.name: Pro views by opening source
insights.description: Dialog opening source is menu, export gate, or checkout return. Already-visible dialogs do not add another view.

insights.name: Live ownership claims and restores
insights.description: Not revenue or unique purchases. A retry or browser/device change can emit another entitlement event, and restoration is not a sale.

insights.name: Live claim outcomes
insights.description: success means signed ownership verified; online_only means server-accepted access without a verified portable license; failure means the operation failed.

insights.name: Live checkout failures by reason
insights.description: Finite reason categories only. No Stripe messages, checkout IDs, recovery codes, or project names.

insights.name: Export failures by reason
insights.description: Fixed failure categories only; generated artwork and document contents remain private.

insights.name: Import failures by reason
insights.description: Fixed failure categories only; filenames and source content remain private.

insights.name: Autosave failures and recoveries
insights.description: Reported only while analytics consent is active; missed offline/declined visits are not evidence of no failures.

insights.name: LCP — 75th percentile
insights.description: Enhanced diagnostics only. Page-lifetime performance metrics from consenting browsers; not a score for all visitors. LCP and INP are milliseconds; CLS is unitless.

insights.name: INP — 75th percentile
insights.description: Enhanced diagnostics only. Page-lifetime performance metrics from consenting browsers; not a score for all visitors. LCP and INP are milliseconds; CLS is unitless.

insights.name: CLS — 75th percentile
insights.description: Enhanced diagnostics only. Page-lifetime performance metrics from consenting browsers; not a score for all visitors. LCP and INP are milliseconds; CLS is unitless.

insights.name: Scrubbed browser error reports
insights.description: Enhanced diagnostics only. Messages, stack traces, private URLs and document content are removed. Counts are reports, not distinct root causes.
